column1: # b09: ovl_intro (src/ovl_intro/DC62B0.c, DC9350.c; DCC450.c is data only): the boot Controller Pak check, three splash screens, then a scripted sprite sequence.
# Core_RunIntroLoop DMAs it to 0x8020C0D0 and calls the entry; Gfx_BuildFrameDisplayList calls func_8020C16C every frame in state 4.
# Sprite slots: D_802684E0[150], word 0 flags: 0x80000000 active, 0x800 move XY, 0x4000 move X, 0x8000 move Y, 0x10/0x20 alpha fade in/out, 0x40/0x80 brightness fade,

# 0x1000 / 0x10000000 wait (the second hides it), 0x20000000/0x40000000 clip grow/shrink (0x100/0x400 pick the axis), 0x800000 front pass, 0x08000000 CI8 / 0x04000000 CI4 / else RGBA16, 0x20000/0x40000 flip.

column3: overlay entry (Core_RunIntroLoop calls 0x8020C0D0 after func_800361E8 loads it): Intro_ClearAllSprites, view rect D_802684B0..BC = (10, 1, 300, 223), zeroes the script position and timers

called each frame by Gfx_BuildFrameDisplayList in state 4: no controller (D_80092C80 == -1) shows Intro_DrawNoControllerMessage; once per boot the pak check (prints "pack_status = %d", picks one of the three pak screens); then the three splashes (START skips: returns 1), a 45-frame wait that starts BGM 0x1B, then Intro_RunSpriteScript into its own display list; core goes back to the title on 0 or 1

spawns the script entries of scene D_802684D8 from D_802170E8 into free slots when their delay runs out, draws both passes (Intro_UpdateAndDrawSprites), advances each sprite to its next animation step (D_80212810) when the step's effect flags have cleared; START fades the screen to white and returns 1, the last scene ending returns 0, else 2
searches every scene's entries in D_802170E8 for the one whose slot (unk22) is the sprite; returns the entry index and stores the scene index, or -1
fills sprite slot n: flags, position, size, texture offset, width (rounded up to 16 for CI4), image/palette, duration, sort key; clears the effect state, alpha 0xFF
resets all 150 sprite slots of D_802684E0 (flags 0, alpha 0xFF)
resets one sprite slot; Intro_RunSpriteScript calls it when the sprite's last animation step ends
counts the slots without the active bit 0x80000000 (not called)
counts the slots with the active bit 0x80000000; the scene advances when it is 0
index of the first slot without the active bit, or -1
flag 0x20000000: grows the drawn width (0x100 set) or height from 0 to the full size over the step's frames, anchored at the far edge set by Intro_SetClipAnchor; returns 0xFF when done
flag 0x40000000: shrinks the drawn width (0x400 set) or height from the full size to 0 over the step's frames, anchored like Intro_StepClipGrow; returns 0xFF when done
stores the sprite's right/bottom edge (x+w, y+h) for the clip grow/shrink; called when a step has 0x60000000
steps unk4E between 0 and 255 over the step's frames (arg 0 up, 1 down); Intro_UpdateAndDrawSprites uses it as the env alpha for flags 0x10/0x20; returns 0xFF when done
same code as Intro_StepAlphaFade, called for flags 0x40/0x80, whose value Intro_UpdateAndDrawSprites uses as the env colour (r=g=b) instead of alpha
flag 0x800: moves the sprite position towards the target (unk2A, unk2C) by |target-start|/frames per frame, snaps to it at the end; returns 0xFF when done
stores the move target and the current position as the move start
flag 0x4000: the x-only version of Intro_StepMoveXY
flag 0x8000: the y-only version of Intro_StepMoveXY
flags 0x1000/0x10000000: counts unk34 up and returns 0xFF when it reaches the step's frames
zeroes the wait counter unk34; called when a step with 0x1000 starts

bubble-sorts the slots by key unk3C, then for the active sprites of the pass (arg 1: flag 0x800000 set, 0: clear) steps their move/clip/fade/wait effects and clears each finished effect's flag (which Intro_RunSpriteScript waits for), clips the rect to the view rect and emits the texture load and texrect (flipped when 0x20000/0x40000) (r2: was Intro_UpdateAndDrawSprites; it also steps the effects)
first splash screen (Intro_Update step 0): Intro_DrawSplash1 under env alpha D_80212250 that rises by 16, holds 90 frames, falls by 16
second splash (step 1, START skips): Intro_DrawSplash2, alpha steps of 8, holds 100 frames
third splash (step 2, START skips): Intro_DrawSplash3, alpha steps of 8, holds 120 frames
draws the 4bpp image D_80264740 (201x18) at (60, 111) in two 9-line strips
draws the 4bpp image D_802650A0 (168x92) at (75, 73) in 20-px columns
draws the 4bpp image D_80267250 (168x40) at (75, 99) in 48-px columns

pak screen 2, chosen when pack_status is -1/-2 (no pak / device error) and neither osMotorInit (func_8003D554) nor osGbpakInit (func_8003D6B0) succeeds: message image with a two-choice cursor; A/START/Z on choice 0 returns 1 (continue), on choice 1 shows a second page until B
drawn by Intro_Update every frame while D_80092C80 == -1 (func_800357B0 leaves it -1 when osContInit finds no usable controller) instead of the intro: one message image D_80260490
pak screen 1, chosen when the pak is usable but D_80092E48[port].unk0 & 0x2000, which func_80035A24 sets when all 16 notes are used or fewer than 2 pages are free: message image, A/START returns 1

pak screen 3, chosen when pack_status is -3 (osPfsInitPak 3/10, inconsistent / ID error) or the accessory answers osMotorInit / osGbpakInit: message image with a two-choice cursor like Intro_RunNoPakScreen (same second page)
